featured.name: Official ATS Convoy - Diesel shortage
featured.description:
### You're **all invited** to haul diesel to Kingman Arizona! 👀  

> Coastline Mining has an urgent shortage of diesel to run all their mining equipment and request your assistance!

The event takes place on the **26th September 2026** at **17:00 UTC!**  

---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your timezone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P01ZlW49IXHTy)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/37508.1787823642.jpg)

---

### :truck: | **Cargo**  

We kindly request you to haul diesel  

You can use our TruckersMP Truck Delivery Dispatcher to select your cargo to Coastline Mining in Kingman.

![Truck Delivery Dispatcher](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/a4ebd34d-accb-4852-9da9-5633020befb0.avif)  

If you want to know more about our Truck Delivery Dispatcher you can read this [article](https://truckersmp.com/knowledge-base/article/1410)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **San Francisco** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you into Coastline Mining.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/120680-official-ats-convoy-animal-transporting/)**!

upcoming.description:
## EQUINOX DAY´S AUTUMN CONVOY!
- Konvoj ku dňu jesennej rovnodenosti!
## 

-----

![](https://i.imgur.com/Lseghp9.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/jD3mPFj/CONVOY-RULES.png)


1. Respect the instructions on our Discord server - **Luky Transport Discord Server.**
2. Drive according to the rules and avoid accidents.
3. Follow company rules, they are of great importance.
4. Stick to the prescribed schedule and convoy plan.
5. Have your job and truck ready at the start of the convoy. (FULL FUEL)
6. Cargo is not limited for this convoy.
7. Confirm your participation.
8. If your company has more than 5 members and you want to participate, you must reserve a slot on our Discord server - [link here.](https://discord.gg/lukytransport)


-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/PCv3Xb9/schedule.png)

*  **18:30**  - Meetup at Frankfurt a. Main at parking slots.
*  **19:00** -  Departure from the Frankfurt a. Main towards A5/A7.
*  **19:45** -  Arrival to the Kiel (short pause).
*  **20:00** -  Departure from the Kiel towards Scandinavia.
*  **20:10**  - Passage over Øresund Bridge - Denmark.
*  **20:35**  - Passage around the city of Linköping.
*  **20:45**  - Passage around the city of Stockholm.
*  **20:55** -  Arrival to the Uppsala, Ika Bohag.
*  **21:00** -  Final Photo and end of the convoy!

![](https://i.imgur.com/qPEhXyX.png)

![](https://i.imgur.com/GKF6CV7.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/CKRRfZ8/CJ.png)

* **1A. Frankfurt a. Main, Transinet - Kiel, Ika Bohag.**
* **2. Kiel, Ika Bohag - Uppsala, Ika Bohag.**

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/Kctz2JT/SLOT-RESERVATION.png)


To ride on this convoy for companies with more than 5 MEMBERS, slot registration is required.

For this, simply use the new slot feature on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/lukytransport).

**Correct Registration Procedure:**

1. [Select your slot](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225995618955300874) with the code number in the room or on the convoy page.
2. Create a new ticket for booking a slot in the [#ticket room on our Discord.](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225533050616676544)
3. Fill out the registration form, indicating the slot you are interested in.
4. Our management will confirm your registration through the ticket.

*Remember to monitor slot occupancy on the server and communicate with us.*


-----

* Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.  
* Participants should park at their designated slots, which is any non-collision company in San Francisco.

* Buses are prohibited.
* Overtaking is strictly prohibited.  
* Free roaming on the server is prohibited.

**Event Rules for Event Staff**  
* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.

upcoming.description:
# COMBOIO DA ALUXION BRASIL LOGÍSTICA
![](https://i.imgur.com/AtY619u.png)

# Setembro Amarelo é uma campanha de conscientização sobre a importância da saúde mental e da prevenção do suicídio. Durante esse período, busca-se incentivar o diálogo, a empatia e a valorização da vida, mostrando que pedir ajuda não é sinal de fraqueza. Muitas pessoas enfrentam problemas emocionais em silêncio, por isso é importante ouvir sem julgamentos e oferecer apoio. A campanha também destaca a importância de buscar ajuda de profissionais, como psicólogos e psiquiatras, quando necessário. Dessa forma, o Setembro Amarelo contribui para combater o preconceito e incentivar uma sociedade mais acolhedora e atenta ao bem-estar das pessoas.
